description: Source code implementing a Zephyr shell command interface for SIP SVC mailbox client operations, including registration, opening, closing, and sending commands.

methods.name: cmd_reg
methods.description: Registers a mailbox client with a specified service.

methods.name: cmd_open
methods.description: Opens the mailbox client with an optional timeout.

methods.name: cmd_send
methods.description: Sends a command via the mailbox with optional timeout.

methods.name: cmd_send_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of a send command.

methods.name: parse_mb_data
methods.description: Parses hexadecimal command data from input string.
